criteria.statement: The reactor subscribes narrowly to trusted kind 31953 revisions and serializes revision handling.
A new fleet revision fans out config.reload to every active OpenClaw soul and emits soul/revision/status observability.
A soul whose kind 31951 read model already records the revision is skipped without runtime or rollout events.
A runtime application failure triggers a per-soul rollback and an error terminal event without advancing kind 31951.
The OpenClaw config.reload target applies the fleet template using normal merge precedence without changing Compose or restarting.
